package.name: Memory Nag
package.description: Keeps a short per-chat vault of roleplay memories and recalls only the unresolved details that matter to the current turn. Add the Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Tracker Agents for Roleplay mode. Once active, configure it in its standalone Memory Nag section.
